ImageDescription.value: Ho Chi Minh City skyline in Bình Thạnh District, wards of Thảo Điền and An Phú, Thủ Đức with Thủ Thiêm Bridge passes Saigon River seen from Ba Son Bridge. The buildings are seen from left to right: Bitexco The Manor Ho Chi Minh, Vinhomes Central Park (Landmark 81), Him Lam Ba Son Golf Course, Saigon Pearl (Opal Tower), Sunwah Pearl, Thảo Điền Pearl, Masteri Thảo Điền, Masteri LUMIÈRE Riverside, The Vista An Phú Developlent (Somerset Vista Ho Chi Minh City), Cantavil An Phú Development (Cantavil Premier), Estella An Phú Development (Estella Heights)
